senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; כמר to hide) trap, small fisher’s net, contrad. to חֵרֶם.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 4:1:11">Y. Pes. IV, 30ᵈ</cite> top; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 2:5:3">Y. M. Kat. II, end, 81ᵇ</cite> <he>צד הוא במ׳</he> one may fish with the small net.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 16:4:2">Y. Yeb. XVI, 15ᵈ</cite> top (prob. to be read: <he>רוֹת …</he> pl.), v. <cite ref="K00817"><he>כָּמַר</he></cite>.—Pl. <cite ref="M01402"><he>מִכְמוֹרוֹת</he></cite>, <cite ref="M01424"><he>מִכְמוֹרִין</he></cite>, <he>מִכְמֵרוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Beitsah 3:1">Tosef. Bets. III, 1</cite>; Y. ib. 62ᵃ top.

<cite ref="Yevamot 121a:15">Yeb. 121ᵃ</cite> <he>מכמורין</he>; <cite ref="Tosefta Yevamot 14:6">Tosef. ib. XIV, 6</cite> <he>מכמרות</he> (Var. <he>מכמרראות</he>, read <he>מַכְמוֹרָאוֹת</he>, fr. <he>מַכְמוֹרִית</he>).
<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 51:13">Pirké d’R. El. ch. LI</cite> <he>נאחזין במכמרותיהם</he> will be caught in the nets laid for them; a. e.
